info.title: APM REST API
info.description: ### Introduction APM REST API exposes a set of aviation resources which allows external systems to interact with APM systems. This document follows OpenApi format standard. This standard allows the external systems to easily integrate with APM systems. ### Authentication APM REST API offers two forms of authentication: - OAuth2 - JWT bearer token OAuth2 - an open protocol to allow secure authorization in a simple and standard method. Regarding the registration of new users, please use APM Settings and create an APM user with the desired user rights to access the REST API. ### Additional information Please be aware that all end points must be prefixed by the server URL. By following the OpenAPI format standard, APM makes simple the integration with third party systems. Indeed, you can use the so called "dynamic" version of the documentation by browsing the following URL : {serviceUrl}/swagger-ui.html . You can test all the available end points and get additional information for each of them.
